description: Weekly dependency updates, grouped per category. Only GitHub Actions and pre-commit hook pins automerge, and only on green CI; runtime dependencies and container images open PRs for the maintainer.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly relock of every poetry.lock; never automerged (see the python dependencies rule for the path scrub).

customManagers.description: The Canopy image digest in pin.py only, behind dashboard approval: a bump also needs canopy_surface.py's VERIFIED_IMAGE re-verified by hand and CANOPY_COMMIT moved, after the sim rehearsal (GeecsCanopy/DEPLOYMENT.md), so Renovate raises the notice and a human finishes the PR.

packageRules.description: Runtime and dev Python dependencies: one PR per week across the lock files, never automerged. Lock file maintenance keeps its own group. Relocks of the four lock files with path extras (root, GEECS-DataPortal, GeecsScanner, GEECS-MCP) come back with Renovate's clone path in the file:// URLs and fail the scrub-lock-paths hook: run scripts/scrub_lock_paths.py and push before merging.
Majors of Python dependencies get their own PR so a breaking change is reviewed alone.
GitHub Actions: grouped, automerged only when every required check is green.
pre-commit hook pins (ruff, pydocstyle, pre-commit-hooks): grouped, automerged only when CI is green; a formatter bump that rewrites code fails the pre-commit workflow and stays open.
ruff's hook pin is NOT automerged: pre-commit CI checks only changed files, so a ruff bump that changes formatting or lint rules would pass green and break the next PR that touches Python.
Container images (the Canopy digest, the Archiver Appliance, Canopy's Postgres and Redis): tracked, never automerged; upgrades follow each runbook's rehearsal.
Postgres and Redis majors are data migrations, not bumps: one PR each, flagged.
The Canopy digest waits for approval on the dependency dashboard (see the custom manager).
The Archiver Appliance's tags carry a prefix: version only the singletomcat-X.Y.Z releases.
